headlines.title: SA moves to bring offshore fund management back home
headlines.summary: The proposed framework would let approved asset managers oversee qualifying foreign portfolios from South Africa, where an estimated R10trn in local savings is currently managed offshore.

headlines.title: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
headlines.summary: A rush of new data centers could bring air pollution roaring back to levels not seen since the 2000s in Texas, which has become ground zero for the physical infrastructure behind generative AI. New and proposed data centers are demanding a tremendous amount of electricity.

concept.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
concept.body: RAG feeds a model your own documents at question time so answers are grounded in your data instead of the model's memory. It's how you get an assistant that 'knows' your business without retraining it.
concept.takeaway: RAG is usually the cheapest route to a trustworthy internal assistant — start here before fine-tuning.
